name: The London EDITION
positioning: Ian Schrager-designed hotel in a restored historic building in Fitzrovia, with Berners Tavern by chef Jason Atherton
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led base in Fitzrovia near Soho, Mayfair and Covent Garden
Guests who enjoy hotel restaurants and cocktail bars

facts.text: The hotel is in a restored historic building in Fitzrovia, close to Soho, Mayfair and Covent Garden.
The hotel reflects the design vision of Ian Schrager.
Guest rooms use oak floors, wood-paneled walls and photography by Hendrik Kerstens to create a cabin-like feel, like a private yacht.
Rooms and suites have nautical-inspired accents and bespoke furnishings.
Suites come with a complimentary gin trolley.
Select rooms and suites can be connected to form two-bedroom configurations.
Berners Tavern is led by chef Jason Atherton and serves contemporary British food.
The Lobby Bar has a communal table, tufted sofas and a snooker table.
Guests get complimentary use of the fitness centre.

highlights.text: The Berners Tavern dining room has chandeliers inspired by those in New York's Grand Central Station.
The Punch Room is an intimate, speakeasy-style cocktail bar.
The Lobby Bar has a stainless steel orb that reflects the whole scene.
The Penthouse has a wrap-around landscaped terrace with views of London.
The Private Dining Room sits above Berners Tavern and is lit by an original historic skylight.

considerations.text: The hotel is within the Congestion Charge and Ultra-Low Emission Zone, which matters for guests arriving by car.
Parking is not on site; it is available at Q-Park on Poland Street, a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning and central location.
